game.title: Chicago Bears at Green Bay Packers

lede: Chicago Bears carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#8 in EPA per play) and the better defensive rating with it, so the ratings point the same way on both sides of the ball.
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Green Bay Packers +0.4 with a fair total of 45.4 — approximately a one-score game, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Chicago Bears pass offence vs Green Bay Packers pass defence, which sits +0.178 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is availability: NFL injury report — not loaded in this session.
